notes.title: Update 3.0
notes.notes:
Add
A new five-dimensional fruit that can greatly increase the attributes of each level of difficulty and nightmare difficulty
Biographies-Biographies of Lu Bu (the level has gold coins and five-dimensional fruit rewards and exclusive support for biographies)
optimization
The morale fruit obtained from 3 stars in the early stage is changed to experience pill
Network Optimization
Level optimization with unreasonable player feedback
repair
Some intelligence strategy errors
Nightmare difficulty gold coin acquisition problem
Some options are mutually exclusive and cannot be obtained at the same time. Equipment can now be obtained at the same time.
